narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh shows $487M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh received 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $60.9M, and obligations are up 10.5% year over year. Ram System Gmbh's obligations by fiscal year are FY21 $136M, FY22 $6M, FY23 $680M, FY24 $11.9M, FY25 $441M, and FY26 $487M. Ram System Gmbh's largest reported NAICS market in FY2026 to date is Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing at $487M. Ram System Gmbh's profile is concentrated in that market based on the available FY2026 to date figures. This summary highlights award counts, average award size, recent-year trends, and the top reported market so procurement teams and competitors can quickly see where Ram System Gmbh’s federal work is concentrated.
